title: Users
description: People who can sign in to this Athena. Admins can change everything; users can run their apps, browse the store, use files and arrange their own dashboard.
removeDescription: They are signed out and can't sign in again. Their apps and files stay.
createDescription: They sign in with this username and password, and can change the password in Settings → Account.
resetDescription: They are signed out everywhere and need the new password to sign in.
